title: PHC Reported Judgment
description: One row from the Peshawar High Court reported-judgments search results, normalized.

id.description: Stable synthetic key: PHC_{year}_{serial_no}. Primary dedup key.

case_info.description: Case number and party names, as shown on the site.

remarks.description: Headnote / summary text. Can be long.

decision_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Null if the site shows 'awaited' or an unparseable value.

sc_status.description: Free-text Supreme Court appeal status, e.g. 'Upheld', 'Partly allowed'. Null if the case wasn't appealed to the SC.

judgment_pdf_url.description: Remote URL of the PHC's own judgment PDF.

judgment_local_pdf_path.description: Path to the downloaded PHC judgment PDF, relative to the repo root, e.g. 'downloaded_pdfs/foo.pdf'.

sc_judgment_pdf_url.description: Remote URL of the Supreme Court's judgment PDF on this case's further appeal, if one exists. Null for the majority of cases that were never appealed further.

sc_judgment_local_pdf_path.description: Path to the downloaded SC judgment PDF, relative to the repo root, e.g. 'downloaded_pdfs/sc_judgments/foo.pdf'. Stored in a separate subfolder from the PHC judgment so the two can never collide on filename.

content_hash.description: sha256 over the site-sourced fields only. Same hash next run = no-op; different hash = the site changed this record and it was updated in place.
